summary: Hoffman Schroff Holdings, nVent Electric plc's financing vehicle, filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for senior notes fully guaranteed by nVent and nVent Finance S.a r.l. Proceeds primarily fund nVent's previously announced acquisition of Maverick Power. A special mandatory redemption at 101% of principal plus accrued interest applies if the deal is not consummated by November 20, 2026 (extendable to February 19, 2027), or if the purchase agreement terminates. Notes are unsecured senior obligations. Watch deal financing risk, outside-date extension, and the redemption trigger versus deal completion.
